entities.name: Carib Dominance — Camerhogne
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Carib (Kalinago) peoples migrated from South America and displaced the Arawaks, establishing dominance over the island they called Camerhogne. Their warrior culture and fierce resistance made Grenada one of the hardest Caribbean islands for Europeans to colonize.
